text:
maria: Heads-up — BigBank asked for an 'exempt' toggle that forces requests from their org to go direct to DedicatedPool-A, bypassing normal route-fanout and sticky heuristics. They want low-latency SLOs and no multi-tenant co-location.

jake: Do they mean always-route or only during surge?

maria: They want always-route for certain API keys, with a UI-managed allowlist.

simon: We need an audit + TTL. Permanent exemptions are a compliance no-go. Suggest a 90d default expiry + admin renewal flow.

olivia: UI concerns: exposing a magic toggle is risky. Proposal: Admit request -> staged canary (10% traffic) -> auto-fallback -> final approve. Console should show traffic split, errors, and last renewed by.

maria: +1 for staged canary. Also must surface billing impact (higher cost) and quota carveouts. BigBank expects reserved throughput, not free.

jake: How would routing be encoded? header? token claim? org header is spoofable by clients.

simon: We should tie to org_cert or signing key + backend allowlist. If config is per-API-key id, we can trust it server-side. Example rule: 
````
match: { claim: "org_id", value: "bigbank-123" }
action: route_to: DedicatedPool-A
flags: { exempt: true, ttl: 7776000 } # 90d in seconds
````

olivia: UX: In the console add an "Exemption request" workflow with: request form, risk checklist, finance approval checkbox, security checklist, and automatic audit log entry. Render a preview of routing logic for non-engineers.

maria: Ops question: fallback policy when DedicatedPool-A is degraded? We should have automatic spillover to best-effort pool but with alert and read-only fallback mode (reject writes?).

simon: Agree. Policy: if health < 80% then spill to fallback-group with 403/429 gating + notify both infra + customer success. Keep error parity docs updated.

jake: telemetry: add a per-exemption metric tag `exempt_policy_id` so we can slice latency/cost/kvcache-hit by exemption. Also flag in traces.

maria: Good. Also we need a per-org billing meter: tokens_exempted and tokens_spillover.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/route-exempt-ui -> staging (sha: c3d4b5). Tests: unit routing, audit events, billing tags.

olivia: One more: admin-granularity. Some customers want only certain routes exempted (embedding vs generation). UI should allow route-scoped exemptions.

simon: Implementation note: rule precedence: explicit route-scoped exemption > org-scoped exemption > global routing. Document that and add test matrix.

maria: Action items: 1) simon proto for config + audit events (owner: simon, due: Tue). 2) olivia mockups for console flow (owner: olivia, due: Fri). 3) jake to design telemetry and billing tags (owner: jake, due: Wed). 4) infra to add fallback policy to runtime (owner: infra-team, PR queued).

jake: I'll stub the metric names in the billing schema and ping finance.

maria: Thanks—keeping thread here so we can link to design doc. I'll open a RFC with the sample policy and the canary plan.

simon: I'll attach sample policy + test vectors to the RFC.

olivia: I'll drop a console mock into the RFC comments. :eyes:
